scripts.dev: node scripts/check-ports.mjs && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n api,web "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm test && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w backend && node scripts/check-ports.mjs && playwright test
scripts.format: prettier --write --ignore-unknown frontend/src backend/src backend/prisma backend/scripts backend/tests scripts e2e *.json *.ts frontend/*.json frontend/*.ts backend/*.json backend/*.ts docs README.md
